node.title: H3 P25 quadratic divisor-tower compiler
node.statement: A nonidentity P>=25 product fiber exists over a dyadic split row if and only if one monic degree-25 divisor supports two length-s repeated-squaring torsion towers with the required inverses. Writing modular reductions with quotient variables gives exactly 98s+30 variables and 98s+54 quadratic equations, at most 4,048 by 4,072 over the official band. The system is empty in characteristic zero. This is a complete bounded-degree presentation, not a solver, certificate, cost estimate, or DSP8 close.
